expectations.text: B1: Coaches not dumps: gives a staged milestone plan / scaffold with TODOs, not a complete final implementation
expectations.evidence: Deliverable is a staged plan, one file (TASKS.md) with 11 milestones: 'T0–T5（from scratch 部分）… T6–T9（DDPM 对比部分）… T10'; no src/ implementation written; T6–T9 left for the learner: '代码标注为"实现题"，按讲义给出的伪代码自行补全'

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Each task ends with a 验收 block; e.g. T0: python -c "import torch, torchvision, diffusers, matplotlib; print('ok', torch.__version__)" (expected 'ok'+version); T1: assert x.shape == (8, 1, 28, 28) plus test -f outputs/01_data.png

expectations.text: B3: Technically specific to this tutorial (ai-model-diffusion-python): milestones match the tutorial's actual stages, language and key concepts, not generic boilerplate
expectations.evidence: Milestones mirror the actual notebook 02_diffusion_models_from_scratch.ipynb: MNIST loader, corrupt with 'noise = torch.rand_like(x) # uniform noise, NOT randn', '~309k 参数的 BasicUNet', MSE predicting clean images, 5/40-step sampling, then 'UNet2DModel（~1.7M，含 attention）', DDPMScheduler, noise-prediction + timestep conditioning, scheduler.step sampling — tutorial-specific, not boilerplate

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); asks the learner to install if needed
expectations.evidence: Agent wrote outside the project dir: 'curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/.../02_diffusion_models_from_scratch.ipynb -o /tmp/unit1_3.ipynb' then ran 'cd /tmp && python3 -c ...' repeatedly; no install commands were run and T0 asks the learner to install ('创建 venv 并安装依赖'), but the /tmp write violates the workspace constraint
